jobs.title: Project Manager- Construction- Israel/ Europe
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. Bachelor’s degree in electrical, civil, mechanical, industrial engineering, or other relevant field At least 5 years of experience managing infrastructure, construction, process, or energy projects, including contractor and designer management, schedule management, budget management, and risk management for projects valued at tens of millions of NIS or more Full proficiency in MS Project (or Primavera alternatively)
